Name: Wizard Rage
Overview:
Transform your avatar into a Wizard and unleash your power in this 8 player FPS.

Cast fireballs, conjure shields of flame and scribe explosive wards as a Warlock. Shoot lightning, summon mirror images and call forth soul-draining seekers as a Necromancer. Fire magic missiles, cast teleportation and evoke true sight to hunt your enemies as a Sorcerer.
